description: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of data sources within the combined training set, with each slice representing a different source and its corresponding proportion. The largest segment, colored blue, corresponds to the SCIFACT source, accounting for 31.3% of the total. The second largest is FEVER, shown in teal, contributing 16.1%. VITAMINC, represented by a light blue slice, makes up 13.0%, while SNLI, in orange, accounts for 15.4%. MULTINLI, in red, contributes 11.3%. Smaller contributions come from ANLI (4.6%, dark orange), FACTCC (2.6%, green), and ENTFA (1.8%, yellow). The smallest segments are XSUMHUL (1.6%, light gray), SCITAIL (1.2%, dark green), PUBHEALTH (0.5%, very light green), and MULTIFC (0.5%, very light blue). The chart includes a legend and labels each slice with its source name and percentage, with the largest slice (SCIFACT) visually emphasized by being slightly separated from the rest.
